description: List error tracking issues with search, filtering, and sorting

from.description: Start time (ISO 8601 or relative). Example: 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z or now-1h

pageSize.description: Number of results per page (default 25, max 100)

query.description: Search query to filter error tracking issues. Example: service:api-server error_type:TypeError

to.description: End time (ISO 8601 or relative). Example: 2026-03-02T00:00:00Z or now

track.description: Track to search errors in: trace (APM), logs, or rum

name: list-error-tracking-issues
